name: Yellow Pages

sources.title: Claim Your Yellow Pages Business Listing — free listing claim page (403 to automated fetch; verified via search results)
YellowPages.com homepage — 'Manage your free listing' entry point

requirements: US local business with a real address and phone number — YP is a local-business citation directory, not a SaaS launch board
Phone verification is required: YP calls the business phone to confirm the claim — you must be able to answer that line
Use a business-domain email for the claim form per third-party guides
preparation: Consistent NAP: business name, street address, local phone, website URL
A person able to answer the business phone for the verification call
Business category, hours, and a short description
workflow: Open https://www.yellowpages.com/claim-your-listing and search the business by name + phone/location
If the business exists, claim it ('Claim that Business'); if absent, create a new listing
Register a YP account and accept the terms; fill profile fields (website URL, hours, category, social links)
Complete the phone verification call from YP
Confirm the listing appears on yellowpages.com search
watchFor: yellowpages.com blocks automated fetches (403) — use a real browser session
YP/Thryv will upsell paid advertising after the claim — the free listing needs no purchase
Phone verification is mandatory; virtual/SaaS businesses without a local number may fail
A purely online SaaS with no address/phone is a weak fit — this is a local-citation play
countsAsLive: The business profile page appears in yellowpages.com search results with NAP details and website link visible to anonymous visitors
unknowns: Whether the website link on a free listing is follow or nofollow
Whether fully-remote businesses with no storefront are accepted
